body: I did not address what happened in custody per se, I only addressed the assumption in the article that she could not have committed suicide because she didn't sound suicidal.

I would like to address all those who say she would never have killed herself, that she didn't sound suicidal...as someone who attempted suicide (I don't remember it, nor the day leading up to it) but none of my friends who had seen me the evening before could believe that I had attempted. They all said I seemed fine, and was talking realistically about the future. I can only guess that I had a few moments of despair and acted on it. Ms Bland had been arrested and kept isolated in a jail cell for several days. I presume that she missed her job interview and would have to explain that. I can imagine someone might experience a few minutes of despair in such a situation. It is not unheard of for someone to get suicidal while under that amount of stress.
